lines.text: The padlock is on, so this site is safe, right?
lines.speaker: LEO

lines.text: Wrong. Nearly all phishing sites show that padlock too.
lines.speaker: MAYA

lines.text: Only eleven percent understand the lock. Chrome replaced it.
lines.speaker: MAYA

lines.text: So my password was about to go to a fake site?
lines.speaker: LEO

lines.text: The lock only means the connection is encrypted.
lines.speaker: MAYA

lines.text: Check the address, not the icon.
lines.speaker: LEO

lines.text: Save this before a padlock fools you. Comment LOCK.
lines.speaker: MAYA
